2. Daily Summary
Today the crew built a scaffold in the stairwell. Before erection began, the work area was documented. Anthony Tomayo, who helped build the scaffold, set the first frame and leveled the scaffold as it went up, with Zuriel lending a hand. The area was closed off with red caution tape, and the scaffold was taped off while it was under construction to prevent anyone from getting on before it was complete. Anthony and Zuriel worked at ground level and passed planks up to the platform, while Luis worked at heights and stayed 100% tied off at all times. Zuriel and Luis set up frames together, and Anthony and Luis worked on the scaffold together. The scaffold was braced to the stairway, and the finished scaffold is shown in the final photos.
